notes: kb/Work/PB452.md LANDED 2026-09-09. FLOAT-NOT-A-NUMBER-SIGNALING stores a canonical SIGNALING NaN with the sign GR35 names - ISO/IEC 60559:2020 6.2.1's quiet bit CLEAR with a nonzero payload. The payload is A.1 item 176's second half, published in docs/CONFORMANCE.md 7 DOC-A.1-176 as ONE (binary32 0x7F800001, binary64 0x7FF0000000000001), the smallest value that keeps the significand nonzero. The CLR has no signaling-NaN constant and every managed arithmetic path quiets one, which is why the value is a BitConverter reinterpretation of its bit pattern - a reinterpretation performs no arithmetic and cannot quiet it. Observable witness: the value is unequal to itself (a NaN) and unequal to an infinity. kb/Work/PB961 (2026-09-22): RE-RECORDED ON THE STORED IMAGE. The prior CONFORMS rested on the emitted EXPRESSION (unit:IeeeSpecialsTests.TheEmittedExpression_EvaluatesToTheDocumentedBits), while the pipeline stored a binary32 signaling NaN as the QUIET 0x7FC00001 - the JIT carried the inline BitConverter constant as a double, and the binary32 image lane widened through double. The value now reaches the item through CobolFloat.FromBinary32Bits (opaque to the JIT) and CobolNum.FormatImageSingle/ParseImageSingle (no binary64), and a same-usage MOVE copies on the carrier (14.9.25.4 GR6 c)). Witness: conformance:cases/14.9.39-SET/pb961_signaling_nan_binary32 reads 0x7F800001 = 2139095041 back through a BINARY-LONG UNSIGNED REDEFINES and asks GR3 k) of every copy; unit:IeeeSpecialsTests.TheStoredImage_CarriesTheDocumentedBits follows the emitted text to the stored image in both byte orders.
